parameter_compatibility.resource_accounting: parameter size, checkpoint size, and shared training memory are counted once per seed

metric_definitions.classification: accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro/micro precision and recall, micro/macro/weighted F1, Hit@1, Hit@3, MRR, cross-entropy, per-class metrics, and confusion matrix
metric_definitions.selection: minimum mean validation cross-entropy across all variants, evaluated after each complete shuffled super-epoch
metric_definitions.kendall_tau: test-node macro Kendall tau-b over all class logits
metric_definitions.kendall_tau_at_3: test-node macro Kendall tau-b over the union of top-3 classes
metric_definitions.kendall_tau_flat_logits: RGCN-compatible Kendall tau-b over flattened aligned test logits
metric_definitions.kendall_tau_confidence: RGCN-compatible Kendall tau-b over maximum class probabilities
